words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}) opens the ayah with active ongoing knowledge, not a later discovery or a passive record. Its plural ending carries forward the prior guardian-scribe group from 82:10-11, so the actors described there are now shown as conscious knowers. The object is the whole clause {{ar:مَا تَفْعَلُونَ}} ({{tr:mā tafʿalūna}}), which makes human doing a determinate field already inside witness-awareness. Unlike the good-deed narrowing in 2:197, this known field is assigned to guardian witnesses and opens onto all enacted agency. The root's mark branch is not the selected sense, but it sharpens the knowledge as recognition: deeds are identifiable, not anonymous entries. The same root returns differently from the soul's realized knowing in 82:5; here the imperfect makes external witness concurrent. The opening verb also sets up the paired -ūna cadence answered by {{ar:تَفْعَلُونَ}} ({{tr:tafʿalūna}}), while the person contrast keeps knowers and actors distinct.

topics.headline: ongoing knowledge governs deed-content
topics.summary: {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}) actively governs the whole doing clause as known content.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the witnessed deeds are not later reconstructed; they are already the direct object of an ongoing knowing verb.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}) as an active imperfect verb that takes the following relative clause as its known content.

topics.headline: plural subject carried from 82:10-11
topics.summary: The -ūna ending carries the prior guardian-scribe group into the new finite verb without repeating the noun.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the prior recorders into this ayah as the same plural witnesses, even though the noun is not repeated.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence marks the 3MP subject as implicit and discourse-linked to the prior plural guardian-scribe group in 82:10-11.

topics.headline: conscious witness beyond recording
topics.summary: The root family allows teaching, informing, learning, and seeking, but the local Form I verb presents settled awareness by witnesses.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the scribes are not only writing or investigating; the ayah casts them as already aware witnesses.
topics.reason: V4 preserves broader knowledge-family movements, but the local simple active verb supports possessed awareness rather than teaching, informing, reflexive learning, or inquiry.

topics.headline: deeds recognized as identifiable
topics.summary: The mark branch of {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}) does not replace knowing, but it gives the knowledge a recognition pressure.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the known actions are identifiable under witness, not anonymous data in a ledger.
topics.reason: V4 lists a distinct mark-sign branch for {{ar:ع ل م}} ({{tr:ʿ-l-m}}), so the image can be retained as narrowed recognition pressure while local grammar keeps ordinary knowing as the selected sense.

topics.headline: knowledge-action pair localized
topics.summary: The common knowledge-action pairing is condensed here into a direct object relation between knowing and doing.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the known action field is broader than the good-deed formula in 2:197 and is assigned here to guardian witnesses.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL intertext with 2:197 survives because the local syntax directly joins the knowing root with the doing clause, while the local object is not restricted to good deeds.

topics.headline: knowing shifts from soul to witnesses
topics.summary: The same root returns from 82:5 with a new subject and aspect.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a same-surah shift from the soul's realized knowing in 82:5 to the witnesses' ongoing external knowing in 82:12.
topics.reason: The 82:5 contrast is concrete and locally meaningful: perfect realization there differs from imperfect ongoing witness here.

topics.headline: witness-first frame and paired cadence
topics.summary: The opening verb frames the ayah as witness knowledge and begins the sound pattern answered by the final action verb.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees accountability staged asymmetrically: third-person knowers first, second-person actors last, with the paired verb endings binding them.
topics.reason: The word order, single-clause attachment, and matching plural endings support the structural and cadence payoff without changing the lexical sense.

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the small hinge that turns the next action verb into the object of {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}). It is relative, not interrogative, and it leaves the object open: not a named sin-class, not a selected portion, but whatever the addressees do. Because the same particle is also completed by {{ar:تَفْعَلُونَ}} ({{tr:tafʿalūna}}), the known field is both the things done and the doing-domain itself. Its non-personal form routes witness to acts rather than persons, and its middle position prevents the doing clause from standing as an independent assertion beside witness knowledge. The short nasal and long vowel make that hinge audible without changing the grammar.

topics.headline: open relative object
topics.summary: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) heads the object clause as an open relative rather than a question or named category.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that witness covers the whole open field of whatever is done, not a named or partitive deed class.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) as a relative pronoun functioning as the object content governed by the knowing verb.

topics.headline: whatever and doing-domain together
topics.summary: The relative object reading remains primary, while act-content pressure keeps the object verb-dependent.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the phrase means both the open set of things done and the activity-content generated by the verb.
topics.reason: The attachment guardrail supports the relative clause architecture and internal object relation; the source-like pressure is therefore retained as a narrowed effect, not as a replacement for the relative pronoun.

topics.headline: acts rather than persons
topics.summary: The non-personal particle routes the object of witness to deed-content.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the witnesses know the deed-field, not the personal essence of the addressees as a class.
topics.reason: The local particle is a non-personal relative whose content is supplied by the following action clause.

topics.headline: hinge that subordinates doing
topics.summary: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) connects the knowing governor to the doing predicate without making the two verbs coordinate equals.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the clause turn from third-person witnesses to second-person actors while human action stays enclosed as known content.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the following action clause as a free relative content clause governed by the opening verb, which supports the CRITICAL hinge and subordination claims.

topics.headline: audible middle hinge
topics.summary: The short particle makes the middle object pivot perceptible between two plural verb endings.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the open object as a brief pause and nasal link between knowing and doing.
topics.reason: The sound observation is local to the surface sequence and reinforces the particle's grammatical middle position without creating a new sense.

words.prose: {{ar:تَفْعَلُونَ}} ({{tr:tafʿalūna}}) lands the ayah on the addressees' own active doing. The second-person plural imperfect confronts them as ongoing agents, while the retained indicative ending states that doing as fact under witness rather than as command or hypothesis. Because it completes {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), the verb supplies the content known by {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}); human action is grammatically enclosed inside witness-awareness. The root {{ar:ف ع ل}} ({{tr:f-ʿ-l}}) is broad enough for doing, making, bringing about, and produced effects, so the clause covers enacted responsibility before deeds are sorted into moral labels. That breadth widens beyond the good qualified in 2:197 and coheres with the later disclosure of even minute deeds in 99:7-8. Its plain Form I keeps that field ordinary and wide, not limited to being affected, contriving, causation, or reciprocity. The final position and matching -ūna cadence answer the opening witness verb and make accountability close on the audience's live action.

topics.headline: direct active addressee agency
topics.summary: {{ar:تَفْعَلُونَ}} ({{tr:tafʿalūna}}) confronts the audience as active ongoing doers.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that accountability is pinned to the addressees as live agents, not to absent people or detached deed-objects.
topics.reason: QAC marks a 2MP active imperfect verb, and attachment evidence resolves its implicit subject to the addressee group.

topics.headline: final verb completes the object clause
topics.summary: The action verb supplies the predicate that makes the open relative object knowable.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that human action is not a separate assertion after witness knowledge; it is the content enclosed by that knowledge.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) plus this verb as the free relative content clause governed by {{ar:يَعْلَمُونَ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamūna}}).

topics.headline: broad doing includes effects
topics.summary: {{ar:ف ع ل}} ({{tr:f-ʿ-l}}) keeps doing, doer, and produced result together in the witnessed field.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the known field covers enacted agency and what it brings about before any narrower moral label is supplied.
topics.reason: V4 supports the broad doing and bringing-about branch for {{ar:ف ع ل}} ({{tr:f-ʿ-l}}), while the local active verb assigns that range to the addressed agents.

topics.headline: plain Form I keeps action wide
topics.summary: The local Form I verb blocks derived-form limits from controlling the sense.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that witness applies to ordinary doing, not only to undergoing, contriving, intensified causation, or reciprocal interaction.
topics.reason: The local surface is simple Form I; V4 branch variety can explain excluded alternatives but does not activate derived-form constraints locally.

topics.headline: unrestricted doing beside deed-disclosure echoes
topics.summary: The ayah's broad doing field contrasts with good-deed restriction in 2:197 and anticipates minute deed disclosure in 99:7-8.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that 82:12 widens the deed field beyond the good qualified in 2:197 and coheres with later disclosure of even minute deeds in 99:7-8.
topics.reason: The concrete references supplied by the CRITICAL rows survive as parallels and contrasts; they do not override the local grammar but illuminate the breadth of the deed field.

topics.headline: ayah lands on addressed action
topics.summary: The final verb closes the clause on second-person doing after third-person witness knowledge.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the ayah move from unseen witnesses to the watched audience, ending on their live deeds.
topics.reason: The word is final, second person, active, and imperfect, so the closing position reinforces the direct accountability already present in the morphology.

topics.headline: closing cadence binds doing to knowing
topics.summary: The final -ūna cadence answers the opening verb, with a minor consonantal texture that suits enacted movement.
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the closing action verb answer the opening witness verb while keeping the person contrast intact.
topics.reason: The sound payoff is tied to the local surface and cadence, so it can survive as a candidate without controlling lexical interpretation.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Knowledge tracks acts brought into being.** `يعلمون` anchors **ع ل م B001** (“knowing a thing as it becomes clear”), and `تفعلون` anchors **ف ع ل B001** (“bringing an act into being”). The preceding guardians and writers supply the means of persistence; I infer that performed acts become clear objects of knowledge through observation and inscription. The ayah reads as process knowledge, not unexplained omniscient access attributed to the writers.

2. **Actions function as identifying marks.** **ع ل م B002** (“a distinguishing mark that points to something”) is activated by the written joining of 82:11. The packet supplies marks, writing, and second-person acts; I infer that each action points back to its actor. Knowledge is therefore evidentiary recognition through traces.

3. **`تفعلون` includes conduct-quality, not isolated motions only.** **ف ع ل B002** (“one’s conduct or noble doing”) is activated by the immediate classification into `الأبرار` and `الفجار` in 82:13–14. The packet supplies conduct and moral classes; I infer that accumulated manner of acting generates a stable evaluative profile. The object of knowledge is a way of conduct as well as individual events.

4. **Contrived acts remain legible.** **ف ع ل B004** (“contrived or invented fabrication”) is activated by `تكذبون` in 82:9. The packet supplies denial, fabrication, and knowledgeable writers; I infer that staged or falsifying performances cannot evade the record by controlling appearance. This exploratory reading remains anchored in the action root.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Verses 82:13–14 reveal that known actions aggregate into contrasting kinds of agent. Verse 82:19 then removes the possibility that another self can alter or dispose of that action-profile.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Their knowledge is act-specific.** `ع ل م B001` gives apprehending something as it becomes clear, and `ف ع ل B001` gives bringing an act into being, whether good or bad. Grammar binds what the observers know to the addressees' actual doing, while the adjacent writing fixes it. The packet supplies subject, object, and sequence; I infer that observation tracks realized acts rather than merely general character. The ayah therefore narrows surveillance into event-level knowledge, giving the later two classes an evidentiary basis.

2. **Acts become distinguishing marks.** `ع ل م B002` gives a mark that differentiates and points to something, and `ف ع ل B001` supplies the deed that can bear that role. Honorable writing precedes, while the righteous/wicked distinction follows. I infer that recorded acts function as marks pointing back to their doers and distinguishing one trajectory from another. Knowledge here changes from invisible cognition into trace recognition: the person can be identified through what the person has caused to exist.

3. **Repeated doing discloses conduct.** `ف ع ل B002` gives *fa'al* as conduct or deed-quality, including noble or blameworthy doing. The next ayat name opposed moral collectives and their opposed states. The packet supplies action followed by classification; I infer that the plural present “you do” accumulates into a manner of conduct rather than remaining disconnected events. The reading therefore links momentary action to durable moral profile without claiming that labels precede deeds.

4. **Fabrication remains an act that can be known.** `ف ع ل B004` supplies contrived invention, especially false reports, and the focus window contains denial (`ك ذ ب B002`) as well as writers. The packet gives false-declaring and an accepted branch in the fixed root for fabricated production; I infer that attempts to manufacture a counter-story are themselves observable doings. The ayah thus undercuts a hidden escape route: a fabricated account cannot stand outside the account of acts.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 82:17-18 later exposed an asymmetry: the observers' `ع ل م B001` knowledge of acts is complete enough for record, while the addressed human still cannot master *yawm al-din*. 82:19 then made action nondelegable; because no self can dispose of anything for another, “what you do” cannot be converted into someone else's performance or rescue.

findings.text: Bilgi, yazıyla kalıcı hale gelen gerçekleşmiş işleri tek tek izler; yalnız genel bir kişilik yargısı değildir.
Her iş, yapanı gösteren ve onu başkalarından ayıran bir iz haline gelir.
Tekrarlanan işler zamanla kalıcı bir davranış biçimi oluşturur ve kişinin hangi ahlaki yönde yer aldığını görünür kılar.
Gerçeği örtecek biçimde kurulmuş yapay anlatılar da yapılan birer iş olduğundan kaydın ve bilginin dışında kalamaz.
Gözetleyicilerin yapılanları bilmesi, yaptıkları bilinen insanın hesap gününü bütünüyle kavrayabildiği anlamına gelmez.
Yapılan işler başka birinin eylemine ya da kurtarıcı müdahalesine devredilemez; her kişinin davranış izi kendisine bağlı kalır.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.

Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar.
